title.target: nàshí de háizi rújīn duō dà
title.english: How Old Those Children Would Be Now

pairs.target: sè lā zhèngzài xǐ yìpén zhānní de cōng , tīngjiàn mén xiǎng , xiān shuō pángbiān yǒukōng pén , bié bǎ bēibāo yā zài tā de gān yīfu shàng .
pairs.english: Sela was washing a basin of muddy scallions. Hearing the door, she first said there was an empty basin beside her: don't put the pack on her dry clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉正在洗一盆沾泥的葱，听见门响，先说旁边有空盆，别把背包压在她的干衣服上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi nuókāi bāo , jiāng xìn jiá zài liǎngkuài zhǐbǎn lǐ de nà yìcéng chōuchūlái . tā táitóu kànjiàn wū yà de míngzì , shǒu tíng zài shuǐ lǐ , méiyǒu lìkè qù jiē .
pairs.english: Tavi moved his pack and pulled out the layer holding the letter between two pieces of cardboard. She looked up and saw Wuya's name; her hands stopped in the water, without reaching for it immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维挪开包，将信夹在两块纸板里的那一层抽出来。她抬头看见乌娅的名字，手停在水里，没有立刻去接。

pairs.target: " xiānxǐ le . " tā shuō , " wǒ zhè shǒu bǐ zì hái hēi . "
pairs.english: “Let me wash first,” she said. “My hands are darker than the writing.”
pairs.hanzi: “先洗了。”她说，“我这手比字还黑。”

pairs.target: tā zuòzài ménbiān de xiǎo dèng shàng děng , tì tā bǎ zhāixià de huángyè jiǎn jìn kuāng .
pairs.english: He waited on the little stool by the door, picking the discarded yellow leaves into a basket for her.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐在门边的小凳上等，替她把摘下的黄叶拣进筐。

pairs.target: cōng gēn shàng yǒu xìxìde báixū , yìtiáo chánzhù le tā de zhǐtou , tā méi chěxiàlái , zhídào tā cājìng shǒu zuò guòlái , cái fāxiànzìjǐ de xī shàng fàng le yìbǎ bùnéng chī de yèzi .
pairs.english: Fine white roots on the scallions wrapped around his finger. He did not pull one off, and only when she dried her hands and sat beside him did he notice the handful of inedible leaves on his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 葱根上有细细的白须，一条缠住了他的指头，他没扯下来，直到她擦净手坐过来，才发现自己的膝上放了一把不能吃的叶子。

pairs.target: sè lā cóng xìn de kāitóu dú . dú dào bèimiàn , tā jiāng zhǐ zhuǎn le gè fāngxiàng , wèn zhège mùchūn chūliù shìbushì xúnrén bó hòumiàn de nàge chūntiān .
pairs.english: Sela read from the beginning of the letter. At the back, she turned the paper and asked whether this sixth day of late spring was in the spring after the search register.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉从信的开头读。读到背面，她将纸转了个方向，问这个暮春初六是不是寻人簿后面的那个春天。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zìjǐ cóng yú wān chāo huí de niánfèn bǎizài pángbiān , liǎng rén duì le yíbiàn , cái diǎntóu . " tā dài le sāngè zǒu . " sè lā shuō .
pairs.english: Tavi placed the year he had copied in Elmbay beside it. After they compared them once, he nodded. “She took three with her,” Sela said.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维将自己从榆湾抄回的年份摆在旁边，两人对了一遍，才点头。
“她带了三个走。”瑟拉说。

pairs.target: " búshì tā zìjǐ de sāngè . shì méi rén lái jiē de . " " wǒ kàndédǒng . " tā yòng zhǐjiǎ yāzhù nà yìháng , yòu kàn le yíhuìer .
pairs.english: “Not three of her own. Children no one had come for.” “I can read.” She pressed a fingernail on that line and looked at it a while longer.
pairs.hanzi:
“不是她自己的三个。是没人来接的。”
“我看得懂。”她用指甲压住那一行，又看了一会儿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng zhe tā wǎng xià wèn , tā què xiān wèn nà sāngè háizi hòulái shìbushì dōu yǒurén dài le . tā zhǐ gěi tā kàn xǔjiā nàtiáo , shuō lìngwài liǎng rén de nà yè méi liúxià , bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: Tavi waited for her next question, but first she asked whether all three children had someone to care for them afterward. He showed her the Xu household entry and said the page for the other two was missing, so he did not know.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等着她往下问，她却先问那三个孩子后来是不是都有人带了。他指给她看许家那条，说另外两人的那页没留下，不知道。

pairs.target: chuāng biān de guōgài kāishǐ qīng xiǎng . sè lā zhàn qǐlái qù nuó guō , tǎ wéi biàn bǎ xìn chóngxīn dú le bànyè .
pairs.english: The pot lid by the window began to rattle softly. Sela got up to move the pot, while Tavi reread half a page of the letter.
pairs.hanzi: 窗边的锅盖开始轻响。瑟拉站起来去挪锅，塔维便把信重新读了半页。

pairs.target: tā huílái hòu méi zài zuò yuánlái de wèizhì , érshì lā guò lìng yìzhāng dèngzǐ , zuò dào tā pángbiān , wèn chí ān rújīn gāi yǒu duō dà .
pairs.english: When she returned, she did not sit in the same place, but pulled over another stool beside him and asked how old Chian would be now.
pairs.hanzi: 她回来后没再坐原来的位置，而是拉过另一张凳子，坐到他旁边，问迟安如今该有多大。

pairs.target: tā ná bǐsuàn gěi tā kàn , suàn chūlái de shù ràng liǎng rén dōu jìng le yíhuìer .
pairs.english: He worked it out with his pen for her; the number left them both quiet for a while.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿笔算给她看，算出来的数让两人都静了一会儿。

pairs.target: nàge háizi xiànzài yěxǔ bǐ tā hái dà , búhuì réng zuòzài mòfáng ménkǎn shàng , děng yígè wènlù de rén lái mō tā de tóu .
pairs.english: That child might now be older than he was, no longer sitting on the mill threshold waiting for a stranger asking directions to pat his head.
pairs.hanzi: 那个孩子现在也许比他还大，不会仍坐在磨坊门槛上，等一个问路的人来摸他的头。

pairs.target: " wǒ pà zài wǎnxiē , jiù dōu zhǎobùzhe le . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “I am afraid if it's any later, we won't find any of them,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “我怕再晚些，就都找不着了。”塔维说。

pairs.target: sè lā shēnshǒu jiāng yā zài bēidǐ de lìng yìzhāng zhǐ lā chūlái , méi lādòng , xiān jiào tā bǎ bēizi táigāo .
pairs.english: Sela reached to pull out the other sheet trapped beneath the cup, but it would not move; first she asked him to lift the cup.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉伸手将压在杯底的另一张纸拉出来，没拉动，先叫他把杯子抬高。

pairs.target: tā máng zhe zhào zuò , shǒuzhǒu pèngfān cōng pén páng de yìzhī kōng wǎn , wǎn zài dìshàng gǔn le bànquān , méi suì .
pairs.english: Hurrying to do so, he knocked an empty bowl beside the scallion basin over with his elbow. It rolled half a turn on the floor without breaking.
pairs.hanzi: 他忙着照做，手肘碰翻葱盆旁的一只空碗，碗在地上滚了半圈，没碎。

pairs.target: tāmen tóngshí dītóu , shuí yě méi shuōhuà , tā jiǎnqǐ wǎn , cái fāxiànzìjǐ yǎnqián yǒuxiē móhu . tā ná bù cā le yíbiàn wǎndǐ . " wǒ yě pà . " tǎ wéi méiyǒu táitóu .
pairs.english: They both looked down without speaking. Only when he picked up the bowl did he notice his vision was a little blurred. She wiped its base with a cloth. “I am afraid too.” Tavi did not look up.
pairs.hanzi:
他们同时低头，谁也没说话，他捡起碗，才发现自己眼前有些模糊。
她拿布擦了一遍碗底。“我也怕。”
塔维没有抬头。

pairs.target: " yǐqián nǐ yí wèn , wǒ jiù pà yǒurén zhēn lái le , shuō dàizǒu jiù dàizǒu . " tā bǎ wǎn fàng huíqù ,
pairs.english: “Before, whenever you asked, I was afraid someone really would come and take you away just like that.” She put the bowl back.
pairs.hanzi: “以前你一问，我就怕有人真来了，说带走就带走。”她把碗放回去，

pairs.target: " nǐ nà shíhòu xiǎo , yèlǐ fānshēn háiyào gǔn dào wǒ zhèbiān . xiànzài pà yòu yǒu shénme yòng , bēibāo dōu zìjǐ huì shōu le . "
pairs.english: “You were little then; when you turned in your sleep, you'd roll over to my side. What's the use of fear now? You can even pack your own bag.”
pairs.hanzi: “你那时候小，夜里翻身还要滚到我这边。现在怕又有什么用，背包都自己会收了。”

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ búshì yào bǎ zhèlǐ wàng le , shuō dé tài kuài , fǎnér xiàng biànjiě .
pairs.english: He said he was not going to forget this place, speaking so fast it sounded like a defense instead.
pairs.hanzi: 他说自己不是要把这里忘了，说得太快，反而像辩解。

pairs.target: sè lā yáotóu , shēnshǒu tì tā bǎ gāngcái chánzhù shǒuzhǐ de cōng xū chědiào , diū jìn yè kuāng , shuō tā zhīdào , kě zhīdào le yě háishì huì xiǎng , shuí shuō zhīdào jiù néng bùxiǎng .
pairs.english: Sela shook her head, reached over to pull the scallion root still tangled around his finger free and dropped it into the leaf basket. She said she knew, but knowing did not stop the thoughts; who said it could?
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉摇头，伸手替他把刚才缠住手指的葱须扯掉，丢进叶筐，说她知道，可知道了也还是会想，谁说知道就能不想。

pairs.target: tāmen zuò zhe tīng le yíhuìer guō lǐ de shēngyīn . tǎ wéi wèn tā yào buyào zài kànkàn fú lán liúxià de yuán xìn .
pairs.english: They sat listening to the pot for a while. Tavi asked if she wanted to look again at the original letter Fulan had left.
pairs.hanzi: 他们坐着听了一会儿锅里的声音。塔维问她要不要再看看芙兰留下的原信。

pairs.target: tā shuōhǎo , zìjǐ qù guì biān qǔ xià jiù zhēnxiànhé , jiēkāi bāo zhe de gānjìng bù . xīn zhēn bāo zài hélǐ zhàn le yìjiǎo , jiù zhēn réng chā zài yuánlái de bù shàng .
pairs.english: She agreed and went to the cupboard herself to take down the old sewing tin and unwrap its clean cloth. The new needle packet occupied one corner; the old needles were still in their original cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 她说好，自己去柜边取下旧针线盒，揭开包着的干净布。新针包在盒里占了一角，旧针仍插在原来的布上。

pairs.target: tā méi bǎ yuán xìn dàizǒu . liǎngfēngxìn bìngpái fàngzài zhuōshàng shí ,
pairs.english: He did not take the original away. With the two letters side by side on the table,
pairs.hanzi: 他没把原信带走。两封信并排放在桌上时，

pairs.target: tā dìyīcì bù zhī kàn nà fēng jiù xìn lǐ xiěgěi yígè bújiàn le de háizi dehuà , yě xiǎngdào xiěxìn de rén hòulái hái tì sāngè háizi shōushí le dōngxī , jiāng tāmen lǐng shàng yìtiáo tā bù zhīdào de lù .
pairs.english: for the first time he saw more than words in an old letter to a missing child: he thought of its writer later packing for three children and leading them along a road unknown to him.
pairs.hanzi: 他第一次不只看那封旧信里写给一个不见了的孩子的话，也想到写信的人后来还替三个孩子收拾了东西，将他们领上一条他不知道的路。

pairs.target: fànhòu , tāmen yìqǐ xiě le huí wū yà de xìn . tǎ wéi xiè guò lǎorén , wèn yuán bó rújīn yóu shuí bǎoguǎn , xǔjiā de quánmíng shìfǒu hái chá dédào , yě qǐng tā wènwèn qīng huái rújīn yǒuméiyǒu néng dàishōu xúnwèn de rén .
pairs.english: After dinner, they wrote a reply to Wuya together. Tavi thanked the old man, asked who kept the original register now and whether the Xu household's full name could still be found, and asked her to inquire whether anyone in Qinghuai could receive questions now.
pairs.hanzi: 饭后，他们一起写了回乌娅的信。塔维谢过老人，问原簿如今由谁保管，许家的全名是否还查得到，也请她问问青槐如今有没有能代收询问的人。

pairs.target: sāngè háizi dōu wèn , méi bǎ chí ān xiěchéng réng zhù zài nàlǐ de rén , gèng méi qǐng tā tì zìjǐ xǔxià huì qù de rìzi .
pairs.english: He asked about all three children, without writing as though Chian still lived there, much less asking her to promise a date when he would come.
pairs.hanzi: 三个孩子都问，没把迟安写成仍住在那里的人，更没请她替自己许下会去的日子。

pairs.target: sè lā dúwán , zài mòwěi tiān le yíjù , shuō ruò yào chāo yè huò jìxìn , fèiyòng qǐng gàosù tāmen .
pairs.english: After reading it, Sela added a sentence at the end, asking to be told any costs of copying pages or posting letters.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉读完，在末尾添了一句，说若要抄页或寄信，费用请告诉他们。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi suàn guò shǒulǐ shèng de gōngqián , diǎntóu yìng le , yòu bǎfēng zhàn de shōuxìn chù xiě quán , zhùmíng míngzǎo chūfā , réng kě jīngxué gōng zhuǎnsòng .
pairs.english: Tavi counted his remaining wages and agreed with a nod, then wrote out the full Wind Trestle postal address, noting that he left tomorrow morning and mail could still be forwarded through the academy.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维算过手里剩的工钱，点头应了，又把风栈的收信处写全，注明明早出发，仍可经学宫转送。

pairs.target: tāmen chèn shōuxìn pù hái méi guānmén , zǒu dào jiēkǒu bǎ xìn jiāo le , fù guò yóufèi .
pairs.english: Before the mail shop closed, they walked to the end of the street to hand over the letter and paid the postage.
pairs.hanzi: 他们趁收信铺还没关门，走到街口把信交了，付过邮费。

pairs.target: huílái de shíjiē shàng , sè lā zǒudémàn , tā yě méi qiǎng dào qiánmiàn , zhī zài tā tíngxià xiējiǎo shí wèn tā míngtiān xiǎng buxiǎng sòngdào nánmén .
pairs.english: On the stone steps back, Sela walked slowly and he did not hurry ahead. Only when she stopped to rest did he ask if she wanted to see him off at the south gate tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 回来的石阶上，瑟拉走得慢，他也没抢到前面，只在她停下歇脚时问她明天想不想送到南门。

pairs.target: " nàme yuǎn , tiān hái méi rè jiù dé qǐlái . " tā kàn le tā yìyǎn , " sòngdào jiēkǒu ba . nǐ kě bié dào le nánmén , cái xiǎngqǐ wǒ tì nǐ zhǔ de dàn hái liúzài guō lǐ . "
pairs.english: “So far. I'd have to get up before the day even warms.” She glanced at him. “The street corner will do. Don't wait until the south gate to remember the eggs I boiled for you are still in the pot.”
pairs.hanzi: “那么远，天还没热就得起来。”她看了他一眼，“送到街口吧。你可别到了南门，才想起我替你煮的蛋还留在锅里。”

pairs.target: yèlǐ , tā jiāng gānjìng wàiyī fàngzài bēibāo zuì shàngmiàn , tīngjiàn tā zài wàiwū nuó wǎn . míngwǎn de wèizhì huì kōng zhe , jīnwǎn tā de wǎn què hái fàngzài cóngxiǎo guànyòng de nà yìbiān .
pairs.english: At night he put his clean coat at the top of his pack and heard her moving bowls in the outer room. His place would be empty tomorrow night, but tonight his bowl still stood on the side he had used since childhood.
pairs.hanzi: 夜里，他将干净外衣放在背包最上面，听见她在外屋挪碗。明晚的位置会空着，今晚他的碗却还放在从小惯用的那一边。
